name: @margoengine/culling
description: GPU-driven static instances: frustum and Hi-Z occlusion culling in compute, order-preserving compaction and indirect draws, no per-part CPU work per frame.
author: Scott Campbell

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.js test/*.test.js
scripts.test:gpu: cd ../.. && node packages/culling/test/gpu/dynamic-check.mjs && node packages/culling/test/gpu/parts-check.mjs && node packages/culling/test/gpu/last-pass-check.mjs && node packages/culling/test/gpu/meshes-occlusion-check.mjs && node packages/culling/test/gpu/models-cull-check.mjs && node packages/culling/test/gpu/occluders-check.mjs && node packages/culling/test/gpu/bounds-check.mjs && node packages/culling/test/gpu/shadows-cull-check.mjs
